headline: Adroit Infotech schedules Extraordinary General Meeting for December 2026
hook: Notice issued for December general meeting
summary: Adroit Infotech Limited has issued a notice to the stock exchange regarding an upcoming Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for December 10, 2026. The meeting pertains to corporate matters requiring shareholder approval. Such procedural filings are standard corporate governance processes for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should note the upcoming date for any potential voting items.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate meeting notice with no immediate financial impact.

summary: Adroit Infotech Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges that November 30, 2026, will serve as the record date for an upcoming company meeting. headline: Adroit Infotech Submits September Quarter Financials
